- Internal restructuring: removed skill-card.md file.
- Added compiled Python cache file (scripts/__pycache__/gdpr-audit.cpython-313.pyc).

- Added anonymous trial mode: up to 5 free cloud-scored audits (7 days) without registration, using a local anon_id.
- Updated description to explain the anonymous trial flow and point users to one-click registration after the trial.
- No code or logic changes beyond documentation/metadata.
- Removed redundant file: skill-card.md.

**Major change: User authentication method is now web-only; direct credential collection removed.**

- Skill no longer collects or transmits your email/password; API Key must be obtained via the compliancehub.cn account page.
- Updated instructions: users now copy their own free API Key from the website and set it via environment variable or config file.
- Security section updated to reflect no in-skill credential handling.
- References to the previous --login/--auth interactive prompts removed.
- Removed the skill-card.md file.

- Added a usage tip: users can answer in Chinese (是/否/不适用), enter ? for compliance guidance, and progress is auto-saved with resume options.

- Clarified that in --non-interactive mode, your answers are not sent and the preview attempts to fetch the latest rules from the cloud, falling back to a built-in snapshot if offline.
- Updated warnings and workflow documentation to better distinguish between scored and preview modes.
- Removed unnecessary files: scripts/__pycache__/gdpr-audit.cpython-313.pyc and skill-card.md.

- Initial release of gdpr-audit skill.
- Provides a free GDPR compliance audit covering 25 core GDPR (EU 2016/679) items.
- Runs audits locally with an optional cloud-based scoring engine (CQDev via compliancehub.cn).
- Supports free preview mode (--non-interactive) that lists all check items without requiring an API key or cloud access.
- Full audit and scoring require a free API key (100 free calls), with simple registration and secure local storage.
- No shell execution or external binaries; clear security and privacy handling detailed.
